name: complete brief pasta
instruction:
Serves 4.

Boil the pasta
Boil 12 ounces spaghetti in a large pot of water according to the package directions until al dente, then drain.

Start the sauce
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook 3 minced garlic cloves for 30–60 seconds until fragrant.

Simmer the tomatoes
Add 1 can crushed tomatoes and simmer gently for 12–15 minutes until slightly thickened.

Toss and serve
Toss the drained pasta with the sauce, divide among four bowls, and serve warm.
